extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires whether funding of £28,000 is available for a client's financial provision action at Edinburgh Sheriff Court, where matrimonial property is around £280,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details of your client's financial provision action. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised and whether any part of the matter touches England and Wales. It would also help to have details of the matrimonial property and how it is held, the expected stage and timetable of the action, and any date fixed for proof. A colleague will review the enquiry and come back to you once we have that information.
